description: Ground truth for grading live-eval verdicts against the seeded baselines. Each entry quotes the vendor's own page. 'review' must be changed to 'human-confirmed' by a person who opened the page; until then grades are reported as PROVISIONAL. Entries whose price was not visible have no 'expected' and are not graded (never guess). Expectations are only changed when new official evidence justifies it, never to make the system pass; every such change is logged in 'changeLog'.

methods.page-fetch: automated fetch of the official page text (no JavaScript rendering)
methods.official-domain-search: official-domain search excerpt (Tavily include_domains), independent of the system's LLM extraction
